name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Avant le § 1 - Am 44
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: -1b. Calls for the EU budget to be ramped up in an effort to tackle the socio-economic plight that peoples and Member States are facing, which has been compounded by, among other aspects, the spiralling cost of living;
